groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code
groups.description: Optional managed-script connector with lazy provisioning.

groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.local
groups.description: Settings of the trusted-development-only local provider.

groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws
groups.description: Settings of the AWS Lambda provider.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.enabled
properties.description: Whether to serve the 'io.camunda:managed-script:1' job type with the managed-script connector.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provider
properties.description: Name of the managed-code provider bean to use. Built in: 'local', deployments in a local directory and Node.js or Python execution in local subprocesses, for trusted development only; and 'aws', one AWS Lambda function per script.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.deployment-name-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of every provider resource name, one per cluster. The identity of the runtime may only manage resources whose name starts with it. A lowercase letter followed by at most 23 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.execution-timeout
properties.description: Maximum duration of one script invocation.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provisioning-timeout
properties.description: How long a job waits for the first provisioning of its artifact. When exceeded, the job fails without consuming a retry and provisioning continues in the background.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provisioning-retry-backoff
properties.description: Retry backoff of jobs that failed while waiting for provisioning or with a retryable error.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provisioning-concurrency
properties.description: Maximum number of artifacts provisioned concurrently by this runtime instance.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.local.directory
properties.description: Directory of the local provider's deployments, one subdirectory per artifact. Defaults to 'camunda-managed-code' in the Java temporary directory.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.local.install-timeout
properties.description: Maximum duration of one dependency installation (pip or npm) while provisioning.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.region
properties.description: AWS region of the Lambda functions. Defaults to the region of the default AWS configuration.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.execution-role-arn
properties.description: IAM role attached to every function. It runs customer code and must grant nothing beyond writing its logs.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.memory-mb
properties.description: Memory of each function, in MB.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.poll-interval
properties.description: Interval between status reads while a function is created.
